Uana: A city girl who could benefit from some unprotected sun-on-skin and perhaps even a bit of mud-on-body, as well as a full day without a shower.
Ubavka: A Macedonian peacock who squawks at the littlest thing. I didn't even know they had peacocks in Macedonia. If she hurts herself down the street, you can hear her wail from a block away.
Ubie: Sneaky and sexy, if Ubie disappears at a party it's not so she can slink off to some bedroom. If it's a boring party you're just as likely to find her in the house next door or over the road talking to the neighbours.
Ula: Ula loves meeting strange people in strange lands. She looks right into your eyes when she talks to you, searching for where you put your love and your hate and all your crazy thoughts. Sometimes, I think that Ula's curiosity is so intense that she's not actually from Earth. If anyone has any theories on this can you please text us up here in the commentary box. Thanks.
Uli: What a well-rounded, sexy, funny ball of love and light and direct questions, she is. Everyone can learn something from this lady. Nope, she’s not from around here and we’re lucky she isn’t, else she wouldn’t be who she is.
Ulrike: As she keeps telling her children, almost to the point of obsession, whatever  you do in life do it to the very best of your ability. Doesn't matter if it's blue water yacht racing, diamond robbery or currency trading. Do it properly and the rewards will follow. (Note, Ulrike herself is tall, usually blonde, very cute, rarely poor and drives a Mercedes, Audi or Volvo.)
Uma: Archaeologist. The last time anyone saw her she was in Peru where she was leading an expedition into a giant Inca temple only recently discovered in the jungle, but that was years ago.
Una: Mmmm, interesting. How do I put this? …… Una is to people what a dipstick is to a car. She goes-a probing with humour and with nous, and only then can she see what's really going on in someone's head.
Uniqua: Well, yes, this is a unique name given to her by unique parents, you can say that again. One might expect her to be big and loud, brash as all hell and ostensibly unforgettable in every arena, but in life Uniqua isn't as death-defying as you might imagine. If anything, she ducks under the expectation of others quite nicely. Perhaps she's just a little lazy or maybe she just doesn't need the limelight? (We suggest the latter.) In short, Uniqua is a cute, modern lass who gets shit done. She has a million friends who, like her, are surprisingly normal and well-adjusted also. Amen to that.
Ursula: A myth. A fable. No woman, no person, is ever this sexy. (With the exception of Susanna, Daniella and Isabella etc.)
Uyen: The Master Strategist, be it for the family business, the marketing firm she occasionally works for, or even when it comes to gaining the upper hand on the newly arrived cat who thinks they own the joint. You can try and outwit her but good luck, Uyen will always scope you out in the end.
